summary: Partitions a byte range [a1, a2) into a3-byte blocks by descending boundary scan. For each boundary i (from a2 down toward a1 stepping by a3), finds the last block start j in [a1+a3, i] (step a3) for which the callback a4(j) reports positive, then swaps the a3 bytes starting at that block start with the a3 bytes starting at i via ByteBufferSwap. Returns the last swapped block pointer. Effectively a descending stable-block reorder driven by an external comparator.

operations.description: Initialize result to a1; result holds the working block pointer and the eventual return value.
Outer descending loop over boundaries: i starts at a2 and decreases by a3 while i > a1.
Inside each outer pass, v6 (the chosen block start) resets to a1.
Inner ascending scan over block starts: j starts at a1+a3 and increases by a3 while j <= i.
If the callback a4(j) returns a positive value, select j as the current block start (v6 = j).
Call ByteBufferSwap(v6, i, a3) to exchange the a3 bytes at the selected block start and the current boundary; store its return in result.
Return result, the final swapped block pointer.
